name: SubscriptionSpec
description:
SubscriptionSpec names the plan an organization is bound to.

 The plan is referenced by its id, not by an organization-scoped reference:
 a Plan belongs to no organization, and the id is exact and immutable,
 which is what "a change of terms is a new Plan" needs. Everything else
 about a subscription is state the payment system reports, and lives in
 the status.

fields.name: PlanId
fields.description: The id of the Plan the organization is bound to.
